notes.title: Digging Deeper - The True Power of Johan "Aardvark" Maes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34123292/1ea2d1478d8d4b77c3313a4f76e1b31d285d7727.jpg[/img]

"He does not chase the fight—he shapes where the fight must happen."
Johan "Aardvark" Maes isn’t your typical Hero—he doesn’t win fights by leading charges or dealing damage directly. Instead, he shapes the battlefield itself. Aardvark’s strength lies in preparation: building trench networks that turn open terrain into fortified bastions, stall enemy momentum, and protect key assets. Used well, he doesn’t just defend—he [b]dictates how and where battles unfold[/b].


[b]Field Manual Update: Revised Combat Engineering Protocols[/b]
Command has authorized the following enhancements to Johan’s tactical utility:


[list][*][b]Trench bonuses now apply regardless of territory[/b] – Trenches could always be placed anywhere, but buffs previously applied only within friendly territory. They now boost Infantry in [b]any location[/b].
[/*]
[*][b]Mobilization time reduced from 1 day to 1 hour[/b], ensuring quicker access to the battlefield.
[/*]
[*][b]Trench construction time scales with level[/b] – from [b]24 hours at Level 1[/b] to [b]10 hours at max rank[/b].
[/*][/list]

No upkeep. No limits. No mercy.

[img]https://www.supremacy1914.com/uploads/pics/1750752906_news_images_34088.jpg[/img]

[b]What is a Trench?[/b]

Trenches are a unique feature created exclusively by Johan "Aardvark" Maes. Once deployed, they appear on the map as standalone defensive structures. Unlike Fortresses, trenches:

[list][*]Can be placed [b]anywhere[/b] on the map[/*]
[*][b]Only affect Infantry units[/b] standing inside them[/*]
[*]Provide bonuses to [b]Defense Damage, Hitpoints[/b], and [b]Combat Strength[/b][/*]
[*]Are [b]autonomous[/b] – once placed, they persist and function even if Johan moves away[/*]
[*][b]Do not cost upkeep[/b] and remain until destroyed or overrun[/*][/list]

They can be stacked with Fortresses for layered defense, or placed in forward zones to pre-fortify terrain. Only the player who placed them can benefit from their effects.

[b]Johan’s Unique Abilities:[/b]

[list][*][b]Field Fortifier[/b] – Build defensive trenches anywhere on the map.
[/*]
[*][b]Earthen Bastion[/b] – Infantry in trenches gain boosts to [b]Defense Damage, Hitpoints, and Combat Strength[/b].
[/*]
[*][b]Rapid Reinforcement[/b] – Higher levels reduce trench build time, enabling faster fortification cycles.
[/*][/list]

[b]Why Choose Johan?[/b]

[list][*][b]Trenches work autonomously[/b] – buffs remain even if Johan moves on.
[/*]
[*][b]No upkeep[/b] – trenches cost resources to place but have no maintenance cost.
[/*]
[*][b]Supports indirect warfare[/b] – control movement, delay sieges, and secure gains without overstretching.
[/*]
[*][b]Ally coordination[/b] – place trenches in allied territory if granted [b]Right of Way[/b]—though only you can benefit from them.
[/*][/list]

[img]https://www.supremacy1914.com/uploads/pics/1750753490_news_images_34089.jpg[/img]

[b]Tactical Use Cases:[/b]

[list][*][b]Early Game:[/b] Fortify chokepoints or delay enemy expansion.
[/*]
[*][b]Mid-Game:[/b] Pair with mobile stacks like Orhan for rapid defense deployments.
[/*]
[*][b]Late Game:[/b] Trail behind your main force to solidify captured zones and deny enemy counteroffensives.
[/*]
[*][b]Trenchcraft Tactics:[/b] Use trenches to protect artillery, encircle enemies, or set ambush zones.
[/*][/list]

[b]Now’s the time to put Johan "Aardvark" Maes to work.[/b] His capabilities have evolved, and your strategy should too.

If he’s still missing from your roster, [b]Hero Medals from ongoing Operations or the Shop[/b] will bring him to your ranks.

“Victory favors the prepared, General. Let Aardvark dig your path to triumph.”
 See you in the trenches.

notes.title: Release Notes - 2025-06-24
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34123292/faf99183487d4640d4c9b8f1be7a05e1bf040eb0.png[/img]

This week's deployment focuses on fortifying the game's core mechanics. These adjustments ensure that the tools of war—your Heroes, your interface, and your reconnaissance—operate with the discipline and consistency you expect.

[b]Hero Vision Abilities – Precision Restored[/b]

Reports from the field noted inconsistencies in how vision-enhancing skills were applied during movement and territorial transitions. These have now been addressed to ensure consistent battlefield awareness.

[b]Tatiana’s “On the Prowl”:[/b]

[list][*]Her [b]Vision Range Boost[/b] now activates correctly [b]only[/b] when within [b]enemy territory.[/b]
[/*][*]Crossing into friendly territory while moving no longer causes unintended unit revelations.
[/*][*]Whether in motion or at rest, visibility is now consistent with her range enhancement.
[/*][/list]

[b]Fiona “Maeve” Porter’s “Eyes of the Homeland”:[/b]

[list][*]Her enhanced [b]Vision Bonus[/b] now functions seamlessly [b]both while moving and stationary,[/b] offering commanders persistent clarity in home territory.
[/*][/list]

[b]Command Intent Going Forward:[/b]

[list][*]Heroes with vision-based skills now [b]consistently reveal units[/b] within their extended range, regardless of movement.
[/*][*]All visual feedback now reflects the actual fog-of-war state, ensuring greater reliability in tactical planning.
[/*][/list]

[b]Army Details – Clear Compositions[/b]

An error previously occurred when inspecting a mixed force containing [b]Johan "Aardvark" Maes[/b] alongside a [b]Trench.[/b] This prevented commanders from reviewing key tactical details.

[list][*]This misfire has been corrected. Army Details now open without issue for all unit combinations, allowing you to assess your formations with confidence.
[/*][/list]

[b]Unit Panels – Cleaner Displays[/b]

Certain units such as [b]Trenches[/b] displayed an empty “Daily Costs” field, leading to visual clutter and confusion.

[list][*]This section now appears only when relevant, ensuring that each unit’s info panel is concise and informative.
[/*][/list]

These refinements aim to keep your campaigns running smoothly and your focus on the strategy ahead. Thank you for standing with us, and for continuing to provide the reports that help steer improvements from the front.

[b]Hold your lines. Watch the horizon. Victory favors the vigilant.[/b]
The Supremacy 1914 Team

notes.title: Release Notes - 2025-06-10
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34123292/faf99183487d4640d4c9b8f1be7a05e1bf040eb0.png[/img]


[b]“Dig deep. Stand firm. The Aardvark holds the line.”[/b]

A new strategist joins the theatre of war. This release introduces a powerful Hero, sharpens the visual clarity of Hero progression, and delivers performance and bug fixes aimed at reinforcing the stability of our battles.

[b]Hero Deployment: Johan “Aardvark” Maes is Now Available[/b]

The time has come to enlist a master of the earthworks. Johan “Aardvark” Maes, famed for his tenacity and trench-building brilliance, is now available for all commanders to recruit. Specializing in defensive operations, Maes strengthens Infantry in trenches and accelerates your entrenchment efforts.

Johan “Aardvark” Maes can be [b]unlocked and leveled up[/b] using [b]Hero Medals[/b], which are now obtainable through newly launched [b]Operation Events.[/b]

[b]Operation Events: Earn Medals for the Aardvark[/b]

To support Johan’s arrival, new Operation Events are now live. These missions allow you to earn the Hero Medals required to unlock and promote him. Act swiftly, command decisively, and secure your place among the fortified elite.

[b]Hero Tier Icons Now Displayed in Army Labels[/b]

A new visual improvement is now active across the battlefield: Heroes now display their [b]tier level[/b] directly within their [b]Army Label[/b]. Whether Bronze, Silver, Gold, or Diamond, these new icons will help commanders assess their units’ strength at a glance and recognize the veterans among them.

[b]Fixes and Improvements[/b]

[b]Hero Promotion Fix[/b]

An issue that prevented some users from promoting Heroes despite having enough medals has been resolved.
[list][*]Heroes are now correctly promotable when medal requirements are fulfilled.[/*][/list]
[b]Global Ranking Search Correction[/b]

A bug where searching for a player positioned last on a ranking page would redirect to the wrong page has been fixed.
[list][*]Searches now display the [b]correct page[/b] containing the target player.[/*][/list]
[b]Trade Offer UI Fix on Mobile[/b]

In the Diplomacy menu, the trade offer text previously overlapped in multiple languages on mobile devices.
[list][*]The issue has been corrected for Czech, French, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Portuguese, and Russian.
[/*][*][b]Android[/b]: Overlap at the top resolved
[/*][*][b]iOS[/b]: Message text is now properly aligned with trade icons[/*][/list]
[b]Final Briefing[/b]

From tactical entrenchment to operational polish, this update reinforces the command tools at your disposal. With Johan Maes joining your ranks, and new clarity on the battlefield, the fight for supremacy is more fortified than ever.

[b]Hold the line, Commander. Victory is earned beneath the soil.[/b]

[b]The Supremacy 1914 Team[/b]

notes.title: Johan "Aardvark" Maes – Master of the Trenches
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34123292/bc9283444c0858cebf3f6d4c141645b78060f582.jpg[/img]

When the shells fall and the enemy charges, one man stands unmoved. We are proud to introduce [b]Johan "Aardvark" Maes[/b], a defensive mastermind whose engineering expertise transforms any frontline into an unbreakable fortress.

[b]Who is Johan "Aardvark" Maes?[/b]

Forged in the muddy battlefields of Flanders, [b]"Aardvark"[/b] earned his name digging deep and holding firm. Rather than leading the charge, Johan shapes the battlefield itself—constructing intricate trench systems that fortify positions and inspire unwavering resilience.

Under his command, Infantry units gain powerful defensive buffs and enhanced survivability when positioned in trenches. Unassuming and methodical, Johan lets his fortifications do the talking—and they speak volumes. If you're looking to make a stand, [b]Aardvark is your immovable anchor.[/b]

[b]Aardvark’s Unique Abilities:[/b]
[list][*][b]Hold the Line[/b] – Increases the [b]defense damage[/b] of all Infantry in trenches, making them tougher to dislodge even under the fiercest assault.
[/*][*][b]Rapid Entrenchment[/b] – Reduces [b]trench deployment time[/b], allowing your forces to fortify quicker and prepare for incoming threats.
[/*][*][b]Earthen Bastion[/b] – Grants a [b]bonus to Infantry hitpoints[/b] in trenches, ensuring they survive longer and maintain the line.
[/*][/list]
[b]Key Stats and Progression:[/b]
[list][*][b]Availability:[/b] Unlock Aardvark from [b]Day 1[/b]
[/*][*][b]Hold the Line Bonus:[/b] +10-50% Infantry Defense Damage (in trenches)
[/*][*][b]Rapid Entrenchment Time:[/b] Trench deployment time reduced to 24 - 10 hours 
[/*][*][b]Earthen Bastion Bonus:[/b] +0-20% Infantry Hitpoints (in trenches)
[/*][*][b]Recovery Time:[/b] 60 hours
[/*][*][b]Daily Cost:[/b] 1200 Money
[/*][/list][b]How to Recruit Johan "Aardvark" Maes?[/b]

Johan will be available through [b]Hero Medals[/b], earnable via [b]special Operations[/b] or in the [b]shop[/b]. Reinforce your defenses and bring in the ultimate trench tactician.

[b]Dig in, hold fast, and let Aardvark anchor your victory.[/b]

[b]See you in the trenches, General![/b]

notes.title: Release Notes - 2025-05-27
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34123292/faf99183487d4640d4c9b8f1be7a05e1bf040eb0.png[/img]

Hero Speed Buff Fixes Now Live!

"A commander’s orders mean little if their troops cannot keep up." – War College Proverb

A critical flaw in battlefield logistics has been addressed: [b]Heroic speed buffs were not reaching their full potential[/b] due to mismatched movement limits. Our engineers have recalibrated march protocols to ensure that your swiftest leaders no longer become the slowest link in the chain of command.

[b]What Was the Issue?[/b]

Several Heroes—renowned for boosting movement speed—were granting bonuses that [b]their own capped speed could not sustain[/b], thereby throttling the effectiveness of the units they were meant to lead. This affected:
[list][*][b]Maeve[/b] – +50% Infantry Movement Speed[/*][*][b]Allenby[/b] – +25% Speed to All Units[/*][*][b]Joffre[/b] – +50% Infantry Movement Speed[/*][*][b]Lawrence[/b] – +50% Speed to All Units[/*][*][b]Georg[/b] – +50% Artillery Movement Speed[/*][/list]
In each case, units could not reach the speeds promised due to the hero acting as a limiting factor in the march.

[b]What Has Changed?[/b]

Effective now, the following corrections have been deployed to [b]restore full speed potential[/b] across the front:
[list][*][b]Allenby & Lawrence[/b]:
Now move at the speed of Armored Cars and [b]apply their buffs to themselves[/b] as well.[/*][*][b]Maeve, Joffre & Bruchmüller[/b]:
Their base speeds have been raised to [b]match their buffed unit maximums[/b]—Infantry and Artillery will now move at full throttle.[*][b]Tatiana[/b]:
Already correctly buffs herself. No change is needed.[/*][/list]
[b]What Does This Mean for You?[/b]
[list][*]All speed-enhancing Heroes now deliver [b]the full benefit of their abilities.[/b][/*][*]Unit compositions that rely on speed are now [b]unlocked to their true potential.[b][/*][*]Your swiftest forces can [b]march at the speed of victory[/b]—no lag, no bottlenecks.[/*][*][b]Note:[/b] These changes apply only to [b]newly created game rounds[/b]. Ongoing games will retain previous Hero movement stats.[/*][/list]
Your troops are faster, your flanks sharper, your momentum unstoppable. Strike hard, strike fast—General!

notes.title: A New Era Begins - Uniting Our Games & Studios
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34123292/4121363bccca97899a939454c095303d0533a8ec.jpg[/img]

Big changes are on the horizon, and we’re excited to share them with you first! After years of collaboration, Bytro and Dorado are officially becoming one unified company. This marks a new era—a fresh start with a new look, new aspirations, and bold ideas for the future.

We are aligning our strengths, refining our goals, and setting the stage for even greater strategy gaming experiences. This transformation is about more than just a name; it’s about reinforcing our commitment to our players and ensuring that our games continue to evolve while staying true to their roots.

[previewyoutube=yrwuWk4GSwg;full][/previewyoutube]
But that’s just the beginning.

[b]A Unified Franchise: Welcome to the Supremacy Era[/b]

With our studios coming together, we are also aligning our games under one unified [b]Supremacy[/b] franchise. [b]Supremacy 1914, Call of War, and Conflict of Nations[/b] will now carry the Supremacy name—creating a recognizable brand that strengthens all of our strategy games while keeping each title’s unique identity intact.

Here’s what this means for you:

[b]Same core gameplay & mechanics[/b] – No fundamental changes to how your favorite games play.
[b]No progress loss[/b] – Everything you’ve earned stays with you.
[b]More content & improvements[/b] – A stronger foundation for future updates and community support.

[b]Rebranding: A New Look, Same Great Games[/b]

As part of this evolution, the games will receive a branding update:

[list][*][b]Supremacy 1914[/b] – Stays the same![/*][*][b]Call of War[/b] – Will transition to [b]Supremacy: Call of War 1942[/b].[/*][*][b]Conflict of Nations[/b] – Will become [b]Supremacy: World War 3[/b].[/*][/list]
This helps players instantly recognize the connections between our games while preserving their distinct gameplay and settings. Think of it like other popular game franchises—different titles, but all part of the same legendary franchise.

[b]What’s Next?[/b]

[b]New Studio Name[/b] – A single name to represent our combined strength.
[b]Unified Login[/b] – Work is underway to streamline access across all games.
[b]Shared Community[/b] – We’ll transition to a [b]single Supremacy Discord server[/b] for a stronger, more connected player base.
[b]More Games in the Future?[/b] – While nothing is official yet, this new structure paves the way for future expansions.

[b]Your Role in This Evolution[/b]

We know change can bring questions, and we’re here to answer them. This is a [b]collaborative journey[/b], and your feedback is key to making this transition smooth. Join the discussion, share your thoughts, and let’s move forward together.

More updates will follow soon—[b]stay tuned![/b]

notes.title: Ranks Reforged - A New Chapter for Hero Progression
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34123292/c8e9e86a419ae2a6e7d12c7f976d3102459c7c64.jpg[/img]

[b]“Progress, like victory, should feel earned—but never out of reach.”[/b]

The art of war evolves—and so must those who lead it. As part of a broader modernization of officer training protocols, High Command is proud to unveil a [b]reworked Hero Leveling System[/b], launching [b]May 6, 2025[/b]. This update brings [b]more achievable progression, refined skill growth[/b], and [b]greater consistency[/b] in how your battlefield leaders advance.

[b]What’s Changing?[/b]
Hero level caps are being raised across the board:

[list][*][b]Uncommon & Rare Heroes[/b] → Max Level [b]10[/b][/*][*][b]Epic Heroes[/b] → Max Level [b]15[/b][/*][*][b]Legendary Heroes[/b] → Max Level [b]20[/b][/*][/list]
But this change is about more than numbers—it's about [b]smoother, more rewarding growth[/b] throughout a Hero’s service.

[b]More Smaller Steps, Less Grind[/b]
In the old system, climbing the final levels could feel like marching through molasses—each step demanding a large jump in resources, with too few milestones along the way.

The new structure introduces [b]smaller, more frequent level steps[/b], making Hero development [b]feel more dynamic and rewarding[/b]:

[list][*][b]Level-ups happen more often[/b], especially in early stages.[/*][*][b]Each level is easier to achieve[/b], reducing the grind without compromising depth.[/*][*]The [b]power curve per level is flatter, but the overall ceiling is higher[/b]—allowing for long-term mastery without bottlenecks.[/*][/list]
[b]Conversion of Existing Heroes[/b]
All Heroes in your command will be automatically upgraded to the new system, with their levels converted as follows:

[table]  	[tr]  	[th][b]Old Level[/b][/th]  	[th][b]New Level[/b][/th]	[/tr]    	[tr]  	[td]1[/td]  	[td]2[/td]	[/tr]	[tr]  	[td]2[/td]  	[td]4[/td]	[/tr]	[tr]  	[td]3[/td]  	[td]6[/td]	[/tr]	[tr]  	[td]4[/td]  	[td]8[/td]	[/tr]	[tr]  	[td]5 (Max)[/td]  	[td]10[/td]	[/tr]  [/table]

No medals are lost. No progress is undone. Your investments remain intact.

[b]Skill Scaling and Rebalancing[/b]
Hero abilities will now unlock across the expanded level range. Skills once found at Level 5 now emerge at Level 10.

A few Heroes have seen minor rebalancing—[b]a trade-off here, a boost there[/b]—to ensure they remain viable and well-rounded across the new level scale.

[b]Deployment Timeline[/b]
This new leveling system rolls out to all players on [b]May 6, 2025[/b]. From that day forward, all Heroes—new and old—will operate under the updated structure.

[b]Final Word[/b]
This isn’t just a tuning pass—it’s a fundamental improvement in how Heroes grow, earn their stripes, and shape the battlefield.

[b]Train smart. Level often. Command with clarity.[/b]

Onward to mastery, General.

notes.title: Cher Ami
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34123292/004c0d7b70af3283ef222313dbe271ba65e356bc.jpg[/img]

War has changed—and so have the pigeons. Introducing [b]Cher Ami[/b], the first-ever [b]avian Hero unit[/b] in Supremacy 1914. Tactical, tireless, and terrifyingly effective, this legendary pigeon is back from history’s coops to wreak havoc on the battlefield.

[h2]Who is Cher Ami?[/h2]

[b]Cher Ami[/b] is more than a symbol—he’s a legend reborn from the trenches of World War I. This brave homing pigeon saved 194 soldiers of the Lost Battalion by flying through enemy fire, wounded and battered, to deliver a critical message. Now, reimagined for Supremacy 1914’s modern battle royale chaos, he returns as the world’s first fully combat-operational bird operative.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34123292/1a62683c0f17387b49b5ddf90d2ff5153cd57f84.jpg[/img]

Outfitted with a prototype reconnaissance camera, [b]Cher Ami[/b] is a scout, saboteur, and symbol of chaos all in one. He doesn’t rely on brute force or heavy firepower—instead, he wins wars with subversion, starvation, and an uncanny knack for disrupting the enemy's plans from the shadows (and from above).

Deployed deep into enemy lines, he silently observes troop movements, hijacks ration lines, and enables an overwhelming spy presence. Commanders who use [b]Cher Ami[/b] wisely can cripple enemy morale, economy, and supply chains—often before the first shot is even fired.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34123292/def300487df3bea853ce6e8373e75392f0562e31.jpg[/img]

[h2]Cher Ami’s Unique Abilities:[/h2]

[list][*][b]Beaked Blitz[/b] – Armoured Cars beware. Cher Ami tears through them with [b]+200% bonus damage[/b], turning recon vehicles into flaming wrecks.
 "The gears jam. The wheels stop. The pigeons don’t."[/*][*][b]Feathers of Deception[/b] – Your espionage network just grew wings. +5 [b]additional spies[/b], +5 [b]premium spy actions[/b] per day, and [b]improved spy efficiency[/b] across all missions.
 "He sees all. Hears all. Reports all—with style."[/*][*][b]Ration Raid[/b] (Activated Ability – 24h Cooldown) – Cher Ami targets a specific Infantry stack, summoning a cloud of rogue pigeons to devour their grain supply.[list][*]Destroys daily Grain supply[/*][*]Causes starvation damage over time
 "An army marches on its stomach. And Cher Ami eats first."[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Key Stats and Progression:[/b]

[list][*][b]Unit Class:[/b] Espionage – Winged Forces[/*][*][b]Rarity:[/b] Epic[/*][*][b]Availability:[/b] Deploy from [b]Day 1[/b][/*][*][b]Daily Cost:[/b] 1 Bag of Birdseed (figuratively)[/*][*][b]Coolness Factor:[/b] 100%[/*][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34123292/5a1f784f4e1e0dd79ea3363f232fc7144e85b6f9.jpg[/img]

[h2]How to Recruit Cher Ami?[/h2]

Available for a [b]limited time[/b] through Hero Medals in special Operations and the [b]Hero Shop[/b]. This April, don’t miss your chance to deploy the only operative who can [b]fly, spy, and fry[/b] the enemy’s plans without ever firing a shot.

He’s fast. He’s feathery. He’s fabulous.

See you in the skies, General—and happy April Fools!

notes.title: Release Notes - 2025-03-12
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34123292/327952d825d572cf0ca6d3688ac363e4ce9fffe9.png[/img]

Today's update focuses on resolving various gameplay issues to enhance stability and ensure mechanics function as intended.

Bug Fixes:
[list][*]Patrol Aircraft Defense Trigger[list][*]Fixed an issue where patrol aircraft incorrectly triggered their defense damage twice when a ground army was attacked by an aircraft. Now, patrol aircraft will only defend once per incoming attack as intended.[/*][/list][/*][*]Area of Effect (AoE) Damage Application[list][*]Fixed a bug where AoE damage was not correctly applied when covering multiple provinces. Now, AoE attacks will correctly impact all covered province centers.[/*][/list][/*][*]Province Morale Damage in Patrol Range[list][*]Fixed an issue where province morale damage was not applied when the target province was within the patrol circle but outside of the aircraft's main attack range. Now, morale damage will correctly be applied if the patrol area covers the province center.[/*][/list][/*][*]Hero Buffs Display in Unit Info[list][*]Resolved a bug where Hero Buffs were displayed in the Unit Info screen even if the corresponding skill had not yet been unlocked. Now, only active and unlocked skills will be shown.[/*][/list][/*][*]Patrol Cone Position Reset After Server Update[list][*]Fixed an issue where the patrol cone for planes changed position after a server update, making it difficult to give new orders. The patrol cone will now remain in its original position after a server refresh.[/*][/list][/*][*]Email Verification Adjustment[list][*]Added an option for players on mobile devices to verify their email address directly from the chatbox.[/*][*]Additionally, now email verification is needed to access the chat.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
These fixes should improve game mechanics and provide a smoother gameplay experience. Thank you for your continued support and feedback!

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where patrol aircraft incorrectly triggered their defense damage twice when a ground army was attacked by an aircraft. Now, patrol aircraft will only defend once per incoming attack as intended.
Fixed a bug where AoE damage was not correctly applied when covering multiple provinces. Now, AoE attacks will correctly impact all covered province centers.

Fixed an issue where province morale damage was not applied when the target province was within the patrol circle but outside of the aircraft's main attack range. Now, morale damage will correctly be applied if the patrol area covers the province center.
Resolved a bug where Hero Buffs were displayed in the Unit Info screen even if the corresponding skill had not yet been unlocked. Now, only active and unlocked skills will be shown.

Fixed an issue where the patrol cone for planes changed position after a server update, making it difficult to give new orders. The patrol cone will now remain in its original position after a server refresh.

notes.content:

The wait is over! Fiona "Maeve" Porter, the Expert Recruiter, has officially arrived on the battlefield. With her unique abilities to rally local forces, enhance mobility, and expand reconnaissance, Maeve is ready to lead your troops to victory. You can now recruit her through Hero Medals from special Operations or the shop. Don’t miss the opportunity to command with strategy, speed, and superior battlefield awareness!

[b]Earn Hero Medals in Upcoming Operations[/b]

To help you recruit Maeve and other battlefield Heroes, a series of Operations will be available:

While flag customization was never available on mobile, this adjustment ensures a more consistent experience across platforms. We appreciate your understanding and encourage you to continue representing your nation on the battlefield in other ways!

[list][*][b]Missing Tooltip for Production and Queue Buttons on Desktop[/b][list][*]Fixed an issue where the “Missing Requirements” tooltip did not appear when hovering over locked buildings in the Construction menu. Now, only active and unlocked buffs will be displayed, ensuring accurate information for players.[/*][/list][/*][/list]These fixes improve clarity and ensure that tooltips and unit details function as expected. Thank you for your continued feedback!

For a closer look at the changes please check out the [url=https://bytro.helpshift.com/hc/en/3-supremacy-1914/faq/560]detailed list of updates[/url] and share your feedback with us on the [url=https://forum.supremacy1914.com/forum/index.php?thread/7880]forums[/url] and our [url=https://discord.gg/JRvh3eDYW2]Discord[/url] server.

notes.title: Unyielding Commander
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34123292/34fd79ec8bb060608b91faaac1103aa40af439a9.jpg[/img]

Get ready to welcome a true game-changer to your ranks: [b]John J. Pershing![/b] Known for his strategic prowess and unwavering determination, Pershing’s command skills make him an unparalleled force on the battlefield, empowering land units with enhanced strength and durability. With his unique abilities, Pershing is a key asset for players aiming to dominate the ground war.

[b]Who Is John J. Pershing?[/b]
John J. Pershing, often referred to as “Black Jack,” was a pivotal figure in the American Expeditionary Forces during World War I. His relentless focus on preparation and coordination helped transform inexperienced troops into a formidable fighting force. Pershing’s ability to adapt his strategies to the ever-changing conditions of war made him a key figure in the Allied victory. Now, his legendary leadership comes to life as a Hero, offering powerful buffs to land melee units and heavy tanks, ensuring your armies are always battle-ready.

[img]https://www.supremacy1914.com/uploads/pics/1734088989_news_images_32842.jpg[/img]

[b]John J. Pershing’s Skills: Master of Melee Combat[/b]
Pershing joins your forces on Day 15, bringing powerful abilities that amplify the effectiveness of land units. At tier 1, his leadership increases the attack damage of all land melee units (Infantry, Cavalry, Armored Cars, Tanks and Heavy Tanks) by 10%, providing a significant edge in ground combat. By tier 5, Pershing’s skills further elevate your forces with the following bonuses:

[list][*][b]Combined Arms Tactics:[/b] Pershing increases the attack damage of all land melee units by 20% at tier 5, ensuring they strike harder and dominate in close combat.[/*][*][b]Hold the Line:[/b] At tier 5, infantry in Pershing’s army gain a 10% hitpoint boost, making them tougher and more durable in prolonged engagements.[/*][*][b]Heavy Assault Formation:[/b] Pershing enhances the resilience of heavy tanks under his command, granting them a 20% hitpoint boost at tier 5. This durability makes heavy tanks under his leadership nearly unstoppable on the battlefield.[/*][/list]
[b]Seize Victory with John J. Pershing![/b]
John J. Pershing’s arrival marks a turning point in melee warfare. His unmatched ability to amplify the strength and durability of land melee units, infantry, and heavy tanks makes him an essential Hero for any player seeking dominance on the battlefield. Don’t miss the opportunity to add his disciplined leadership to your army. Stay tuned to our official channels, including the [url=https://forum.supremacy1914.com/forum/]forum[/url] and our [url=https://discord.gg/JRvh3eDYW2]Discord[/url], for more updates on the arrival of our next exciting Hero.

notes.title: Hero of Tsushima
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34123292/828a24c221f1b82665c9a9d6ca43c83020fdf1f7.jpg[/img]

We’re very excited to announce that our first naval Hero is set to chart a course to your ranks soon. Introducing [b]Tōgō Heihachirō[/b], the esteemed Japanese Admiral and one of history’s greatest naval tacticians. The arrival of Tōgō will mark the beginning of new and thrilling possibilities. Not only will he be the first much anticipated naval Hero, but he also brings with him a ground-breaking new skill that will revolutionise your gameplay: Bombardment. With this you’ll be able to unleash a devastating attack to units in a selected area at sea and on coastlines that will last for hours, along with Tōgō’s impressive buffs to battleships hitpoints and attack damage.

[b]Who Is Tōgō Heihachirō?[/b]
Born in 1848 in Kagoshima, Japan, Tōgō Heihachirō rose to prominence as the architect of modern naval strategy. From humble beginnings in a samurai family, Tōgō’s determination and talent earned him opportunities to study abroad, where he gained invaluable insights into Western naval tactics and technology. His ability to combine traditional Japanese discipline with cutting-edge Western strategies brought innovation and precision to the Imperial Japanese Navy. These qualities shone brightest during the Russo-Japanese War, where his decisive victories - particularly at the Battle of Tsushima - cemented his reputation as one of history’s greatest naval commanders.

[img]https://www.supremacy1914.com/uploads/pics/1733480289_news_images_32783.jpg[/img]

[b]Tōgō Heihachirō’s Skills: Master of Naval Warfare[/b]
When Tōgō joins your forces on Day 12, he brings an unprecedented new ability to naval combat: Bombardment. Starting at tier 1, this skill allows you to strategically target enemy positions from afar, dealing massive damage over time. Within a range of 75 he can unleash a bombardment damaging all units in a selected area at sea, or within a short range along the shore. This will deal 15 damage per attack round, lasting for 6 hours. The ability comes with an additional cost of oil and gas, and takes 2 hours to deploy. notes.title: Release Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34123292/7e79f8ea0bf87409bbc0ebc1ec953e758cfcae65.jpg[/img]

Attention, General!

Today's update marks the arrival of three new Heroes, ready to bolster your ranks and contribute on your road to victory. Not only do they each come with a new set of skills, but they also introduce new types of skills. The ability to raise the sturdiness of troops by directly increasing their maximum hit points is now a possibility for Heroes. Additionally, territory specific skills are also added. A defensive expert might only apply his expertise when fighting in a province controlled by your nation, while others might excel only when positioned within hostile terrain. 

Let's take a closer look at Supremacy 1914's newest Heroes and their skills:
[list][*][b]Fiero “Marco” Martello:[/b] This gifted mechanic’s skills enhance the durability and firepower of your light tanks, making these already destructive units even more powerful than before.[/*][*][b]Joseph Joffre:[/b] Whose tactical brilliance will make it easier for you to defend your territory, in even the toughest of situations.[/*][*][b]Tatiana Minchakievich:[/b] Her ranged capabilities, combined with skills that boost her own and infantry movement speed, make her a deadly force to be reckoned with. She also gains increased vision range and amplified damage in enemy territory, giving her a fierce edge on hostile ground.[/*][/list]
Start participating in operations now to begin collecting the medals needed to unlock and promote these new Heroes. Don’t forget that you can also collect Hero medals from your daily free gifts, and purchase them in the shop.

Along with the release of 3 new Heroes, we have also added the option to speed up Hero recovery times, ensuring your best leaders are ready for action when you need them most. To account for this, we’ve also increased the recovery time of each Hero by 24 hours each. We’ve also fixed two visual bugs that were causing rank progression to overflow outside the XP bar, and some tooltips to be much wider than intended. Now you can continue making your battle plans with everything in place where they belong.

For a closer look at the changes please check out the [url=https://bytro.helpshift.com/hc/en/3-supremacy-1914/faq/544]detailed list of updates[/url] and share your feedback with us on the [url=https://forum.supremacy1914.com/forum/index.php?thread/7757]forums[/url] and our [url=https://discord.gg/JRvh3eDYW2]Discord[/url] server.

Best of luck General,
Your Bytro Team

notes.title: Angel of Death
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34123292/371c6e4af0989a262d8747ae0baf11c2c5fc2f75.jpg[/img]
A deadly new Hero is on the way: [b]Tatiana Minchakievich[/b], a skilled sniper and scout known for her ability to operate deep in enemy territory. This legendary Hero is a ranged attacker who is sure to bring a whole new level of depth to your gameplay.

[b]Who Is Tatiana Minchakievich?[/b]
Little is known of Tatiana’s life before the war, but together with her sister Olga, she volunteered for the all-women “Battalion of Death,” enduring under their commander’s rigorous discipline. Tatiana quickly established herself as an exceptional sniper, feared for her accuracy and her unmatched marksmanship. Favoring covert operations over direct confrontation, she uses terrain and her swift movements to strike from the shadows, gather intelligence, and spread fear throughout enemy lines.

[img]https://www.supremacy1914.com/uploads/pics/1730993494_news_images_32372.jpg[/img]

[b]Tatiana Minchakievich’s Skills: Master of Precision[/b]
Tatiana is a ranged unit with skills that enhance her lethality, vision, and mobility. She starts out with an attack range of 30, and with a 100% damage boost and 20% vision boost while in enemy territory. At her peak in [b]tier 5[/b], her abilities reach their full potential as she unlocks a third skill and gains the following enhancements:
[list][*][b]Shoot to Kill:[/b] Tatiana’s damage output in enemy territory rises to an impressive 250%, allowing her to inflict maximum damage and terrorize opponents behind enemy lines.[/*][*][b]On the Prowl:[/b] Her scouting abilities reach their peak with a 100% vision range boost in enemy territory, ensuring her unit can uncover enemy positions and threats from afar.[/*][*][b]Strike and Fade:[/b] Tatiana and the Infantry under her command gain a 30% movement speed boost, allowing for swift, strike-and-fade maneuvers that keep her forces mobile and unpredictable.[/*][/list][b]The New Heroes Approach![/b]
Tatiana is the third of three brand new Heroes coming soon, along with the previously announced Fiero Martello and Joseph Joffre. Start planning your strategies and keep an eye on our official channels, including the [url=https://forum.supremacy1914.com/forum/]forum[/url] and our [url=https://discord.gg/JRvh3eDYW2]Discord[/url]  server for more information on their arrival and other updates.

notes.title: Defender of France
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34123292/36040b8aba3492a7e29cf00ef08a0d6b17750376.jpg[/img]

A powerful new hero will soon join your ranks: [b]Joseph Joffre[/b], the Commander-in-Chief of the French army known as the "Victor of the Marne" for his crucial role in halting the German advance in 1914. Joffre’s unparalleled defensive expertise makes him a formidable force on the battlefield.

[b]Who Is Joseph Joffre?[/b]
Joseph Joffre made history by leading the French army to a decisive victory during the First Battle of the Marne. His calmness under pressure and tactical brilliance stopped the German offensive in its tracks, earning him the admiration of his soldiers and the world. Known for his defensive mastery, Joffre focuses on fortifying friendly provinces, ensuring that his forces are always ready to repel enemy attacks. His leadership enhances the strength and mobility of Infantry and Armored Cars, making him an indispensable asset in defending your homeland.

[img]https://www.supremacy1914.com/uploads/pics/1730456579_news_images_32315.jpg[/img]

[b]Joseph Joffre’s Skills: Master of Defense[/b]
When Joffre joins your forces, he brings with him skills designed to bolster the defense of your home territory. His Defender of the Homeland skill gives a 5% defense buff to Infantry and Armored Cars in his army. This bonus applies while positioned in your own territory. When fully promoted to [b]tier 5[/b], this Epic Hero’s abilities further strengthen your forces with the following enhancements:

[list][*][b]Defender of the Homeland:[/b] This skill provides a 15% defense buff to all Infantry and Armored Cars in Joffre’s army when they are defending your provinces, making it much harder for enemies to penetrate your defenses.[/*][*][b]Hold Your Ground:[/b] Joffre increases the hitpoints of all Armored Cars in his army by 15% while they are in your own territory, ensuring they can absorb more damage and hold critical positions against enemy assaults.[/*][*][b]Rapid Redeployment:[/b] In addition to his defensive buffs, Joffre improves the mobility of Infantry in his army by increasing their movement speed by 30% within your own provinces, allowing for quick and organized responses to shifting threats.[/*][/list]
Joseph Joffre is coming soon, bringing his defensive mastery to your army and offering new strategic possibilities for protecting your territory. Stay tuned to our official channels, including the [url=https://forum.supremacy1914.com/forum/]forum[/url] and our Official [url=https://discord.gg/JRvh3eDYW2]Discord[/url] server, for more details on his arrival and the latest updates to the game.

notes.title: Master Engineer
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34123292/81b3c281c4e4299e1d79dba0ebd8900e9bed7880.jpg[/img]

Get ready to welcome a new hero to your forces: [b]Fiero “Marco” Martello[/b], a renowned mechanic from Italy. His unmatched skills as an engineer mean you can rest assured that your light tanks will be in peak condition - ready to handle any challenge.

[b]Who Is Fiero Martello?[/b]
Shortly after the war began, Fiero Martello was drafted to the Italian military where he served as a mechanic. His skill as an engineer made him an invaluable member of his unit thanks to his ability to keep tanks in perfect working order, even in the most challenging conditions. Whether in the workshop or on the battlefield, Marco ensured that every tank under his care was a reliable and formidable machine, embodying his dedication and technical mastery.

[img]https://www.supremacy1914.com/uploads/pics/1730456631_news_images_32316.jpg[/img]

[b]Fiero Martello’s Skills: Tank Mechanic[/b]
When Marco joins your ranks, he brings with him skills that enhance the durability and firepower of your light tank units. His Armorer skill provides a 5% increase to light tank damage when first unlocked, ensuring that your light tanks can deal more damage in combat. As you upgrade this Uncommon Hero to tier 5, his skills evolve further with the following enhancements:
[list][*][b]Armorer:[/b] At tier 5, Marco’s expertise increases the damage output of light tanks in his army by 15%, turning your armored units into even more destructive forces on the battlefield.[/*][*][b]Regular Maintenance:[/b] In addition to increased firepower, Marco ensures that all light tanks in his army receive 10% more hit points at tier 5. This boost to their durability makes them tougher to defeat, allowing your light tanks to withstand greater damage and continue fighting longer.[/*][/list]
Fiero “Marco” Martello will soon be available to join your forces, bringing his unmatched engineering skills and expertise in tank maintenance to the front lines. Be sure to follow our official channels, including the [url=https://forum.supremacy1914.com/forum/]forum[/url] and our Official [url=https://discord.gg/JRvh3eDYW2]Discord[/url] server, for more details on his arrival and other upcoming updates.

notes.title: The Desert Legend
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34123292/b23392184e5798555a0708427427c2154f9788fa.jpg[/img]

Prepare to welcome a legendary figure into your ranks with the upcoming Heroes update: T. E. Lawrence, famously known as [b]"Lawrence of Arabia”[/b]. Renowned for his critical role in the collapse of the Ottoman Empire, Lawrence’s mastery of guerilla warfare and his ability to unite disparate militias under a single cause made him a formidable force in the desert. We're thrilled to introduce you to this extraordinary leader. His unmatched tactics and fierce independence make him a fearsome opponent, capable of striking with devastating precision even when separated from his men.

[b]Who Is T. E. Lawrence?[/b]
T. E. Lawrence, later immortalized as "Lawrence of Arabia," was a British officer who played a pivotal role in the Arab Revolt against the Ottoman Empire during World War I. Operating in the harsh deserts of the Middle East, Lawrence became a master of guerilla warfare, leading his forces on lightning-fast raids that targeted key infrastructure and supply lines. His ability to rally diverse rebel bands, combined with his deep understanding of the terrain and enemy tactics, allowed him to exploit vulnerabilities and bring a powerful empire to its knees. Lawrence’s legend grew not just from his victories but from his ability to inspire and lead men from all walks of life in the harshest of conditions.

[img]https://www.supremacy1914.com/uploads/pics/1725374066_news_images_31552.jpg[/img]

[b]Lawrence of Arabia’s Skills: Master of Guerilla Warfare:[/b]
Once Lawrence of Arabia is unlocked at tier 1, he is deployable from day 3 and starts with a substantial 50% boost to his own damage, making him a deadly force on the battlefield. As you advance him to tier 5, his full potential is unleashed with the following skills:
[list][*][b]Seven Pillars:[/b] At tier 5, Lawrence’s damage output skyrockets with a 150% boost to his own strength, allowing him to decimate even the most fortified enemies. This skill ensures that Lawrence remains a formidable threat, capable of turning the tide of battle with his sheer destructive power.[/*][*][b]Swift Command:[/b] Lawrence’s command of the battlefield also extends to the units under his leadership. All units in his army receive a 20% movement speed boost, enabling them to outmaneuver opponents, execute rapid strikes, and reposition with unmatched agility.[/*][*][b]Personal Bodyguard: Infantry:[/b] Lawrence enters the battlefield accompanied by 20 infantry units, ready for combat. These troops, bolstered by Lawrence's leadership, provide essential support, significantly enhancing his overall impact in battle.[/*][/list]
[b]Prepare for the Heroes Update![/b]
Lawrence of Arabia is the final addition in the upcoming Heroes update. Keep a close eye on operations after the Heroes are released so you don’t miss out on crucial opportunities to collect medals for him. To further speed up progression with Lawrence, check out our community center, where you also get your daily free gifts. Stay tuned to our official channels, including the [url=https://forum.supremacy1914.com/forum/]forum[/url] and our [url=https://discord.gg/JRvh3eDYW2]Discord[/url] server, for the latest news and updates.

notes.title: Release Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34123292/327952d825d572cf0ca6d3688ac363e4ce9fffe9.png[/img]

Attention, General!

In today’s update we’ve made some key adjustments to the recent fortress balancing changes, enhanced new players' experience with the game and squashed two pesky bugs. Check out the details below to stay on top of the latest improvements.
[list][*][b]Fortress Changes:[/b] We’ve made some improvements to the recent fortress balancing changes based on player feedback. Each level of fortress now has 50 hit points, which has increased from 40 hit points per level, making them more durable and better for defense in comparison to Armored Cars. We’ve also reduced the days of availability for fortresses from level 2 onwards by one day for each level. This makes it possible to start building a level 2 fortress from day 1, since we previously reduced the build time for level 1 forts. As usual, these changes will only affect maps that were created after today’s update.[/*][*][b]Maximum rank for tutorial maps:[/b] To ensure that our newer players have the best learning experience, tutorial maps are now limited to players up to rank 4. This change allows beginners to get a feel for the battlefield without facing off against more seasoned players, ensuring a fair and balanced start to their games.[/*][*][b]4x speed maps for seasoned players:[/b] We understand that a lot of seasoned players prefer the option of playing a speed map without needing to wait for events. Due to the maximum rank being added to the tutorial map, we have also created 4x speed Great War and Shattered America maps for players with minimum rank 5 or higher. Now everyone can enjoy the game at 4 speed at any time, in a fairer way for beginners.[/*][*][b]Card Deployment Interface on Desktop:[/b] We’ve resolved an issue where the deployment interface wasn’t launching when trying to use unit cards while a unit was already selected on the map. This bug also caused some confusion by making the in-game menu icons disappear after clicking "Continue." With this patch, your deployment tools and interface are back in full operational order.[/*][*][b]Zeppelin Card Over-deployment:[/b] There was a bug where deploying Zeppelin cards sometimes launched two Zeppelins instead of one. This issue has been fixed, so these units now deploy with the correct amount again.[/*][/list]
For a closer look at the changes please check out the <a onclick="hup.navigationHelper.openExternalURL('https://bytro.helpshift.com/hc/en/3-supremacy-1914/faq/535')">detailed list of updates[/url] and share your feedback with us on the [url=https://forum.supremacy1914.com/forum/index.php?thread/7691]forums[/url] and our [url=https://discord.gg/JRvh3eDYW2]Discord[/url] server.

Best of luck General,
Your Bytro Team

notes.title: Master of Artillery
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34123292/235f8f59ba8a6a68a9734b4e693e0bd6eedfc741.jpg[/img]

In the upcoming Heroes update, a new figure renowned for his groundbreaking military tactics is set to join your ranks: [b]Georg "Breakthrough-Müller" Bruchmüller[/b]. As we move closer to the release, we're excited to introduce you to this master tactician, whose expertise in artillery will transform your combat strategies and bring unprecedented firepower to your forces.

[b]Who Is Georg "Breakthrough-Müller" Bruchmüller?[/b]
Georg Bruchmüller, nicknamed "Breakthrough-Müller" by his comrades, was a visionary military strategist who reshaped the use of artillery in warfare. Faced with the grueling stalemate of trench warfare, Bruchmüller devised a series of rapid, coordinated bombardments that shattered enemy defenses and opened the way for decisive breakthroughs. His meticulous planning and ability to synchronize artillery fire with infantry advances made him a formidable force on the battlefield. Under his command, artillery units became not just instruments of destruction, but keys to victory, striking with precision and redeploying with unmatched speed.

[img]https://www.supremacy1914.com/uploads/pics/1725373643_news_images_31551.jpg[/img]
[b]Georg Bruchmüller’s Skills: Artillery Commander:[/b]
When Bruchmüller joins your forces from day 10 onwards, he brings with him a set of skills that significantly enhance the combat effectiveness of all artillery units in his army. Once unlocked and starting at tier 1, his presence provides a 10% attack damage buff to all artillery in his army, making them more lethal in battle. As you upgrade him to tier 5, his influence grows even stronger with the following skills:
[list][*][b]Artillery Barrage:[/b] When fully upgraded, Bruchmüller’s command increases the attack damage of all artillery in his army by 25%, turning your artillery units into devastating forces of destruction capable of overwhelming enemy defenses.[/*][*][b]Mobile Firepower:[/b] Additionally, Bruchmüller’s expertise in rapid redeployment grants all artillery in his stack a 20% movement speed buff. This ensures that your artillery can quickly reposition to maintain pressure on the enemy and adapt to the flow of battle.[/*][*][b]Personal Bodyguard:[/b] Artillery: At tier 5, Bruchmüller doesn’t just bring his strategic prowess - he also arrives on the battlefield with two artillery units ready for action. These units, enhanced by his leadership, provide immediate firepower, making Bruchmüller a crucial force in any engagement.[/*][/list]
[b]Prepare for the Heroes Update![/b]
Georg Bruchmüller is just one of the many exciting additions in the upcoming Heroes update. As we prepare for this release, remember that Heroes like Bruchmüller will play a critical role in your strategy, offering unique advantages that can redefine the course of your battles. Stay tuned to our official channels, including the [url=https://forum.supremacy1914.com/forum/]forum[/url] and our Official [url=https://discord.gg/JRvh3eDYW2]Discord[/url] server, for the latest news and updates.

notes.title: Release Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34123292/327952d825d572cf0ca6d3688ac363e4ce9fffe9.png[/img]

Attention, General!

In today’s update, we’ve implemented some balancing changes for fortresses, and fixed some crucial bugs. Let’s take a look!

[b]Fortress Balancing Update:[/b]

We've identified some key issues with Fortresses, particularly in early-game scenarios where their long build times and vulnerability made them less effective. To address this, we've rebalanced Fortresses across all levels to improve their usability, especially in low morale territories and early confrontations.

[list][*][b]Fortress Level 1:[/b][/*][list][*][b]Construction Time:[/b] Reduced from 24 hours to 8 hours.[/*][*][b]Defense Bonus:[/b] Adjusted from 50% to 30%.[/*][*][b]Hitpoints:[/b] Increased from 20 to 40.[/*][*][b]Minimum Condition:[/b] Fortress level 1 begins offering some protection bonus at 10 HP (25% of total HP), which increases gradually as it builds until it’s complete. This begins with the first hit point in each of the next levels.[/*][/list][*][b]Fortress Level 2:[/b][/*][list][*][b]Construction Time:[/b] Reduced from 24 hours to 16 hours.[/*][*][b]Defense Bonus:[/b] Adjusted from 60% to 45%.[/*][*][b]Additional Hitpoints:[/b] Increased from 25 to 40.[/*][/list][*][b]Fortress Level 3:[/b][/*][list][*][b]Construction Time:[/b] Remains at 24 hours.[/*][*][b]Defense Bonus:[/b] Adjusted from 70% to 60%.[/*][*][b]Additional Hitpoints:[/b] Increased from 30 to 40.[/*][/list][*][b]Fortress Level 4:[/b][/*][list][*][b]Construction Time:[/b] Increased from 24 hours to 32 hours.[/*][*][b]Defense Bonus:[/b] Adjusted from 80% to 75%.[/*][*][b]Additional Hitpoints:[/b] Increased from 35 to 40.[/*][/list][*][b]Fortress Level 5:[/b][/*][list][*][b]Construction Time:[/b] Increased from 24 hours to 40 hours.[/*][*][b]Defense Bonus:[/b] Remains at 90%.[/*][*][b]Additional Hitpoints:[/b] Fixed at 40.[/*][/list][/list]
These changes make Fortresses faster to build on the frontlines and more durable in prolonged battles, ensuring they remain a strong defensive option. While the defense bonus is slightly reduced for shorter engagements, their increased hit points mean they can endure longer, and provide consistent protection, even shielding other structures in your province. These changes will only affect maps that are created after today’s update.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b][list][*][b]Idle Troops in Allied Territory:[/b] We resolved a bug where idle troops were automatically attacking instead of defending when attacked in allied territory.[/*][*][b]Tutorial Tips Not Fully Readable:[/b] We've fixed an issue where, in some languages, text overflowed and images were not properly centred in the tutorial box.[/*][/list]
We are also in the process of implementing a moderation tool that automatically checks the newspaper for prohibited content. These fixes enhance the game's usability and ensure smoother gameplay experiences across different languages and scenarios. Prepare your defenses, Generals, and make the most of these fortified improvements!

For a closer look at the changes please check out the [url=https://bytro.helpshift.com/hc/en/3-supremacy-1914/faq/532]detailed list of updates[/url] and share your feedback with us on the [url=https://forum.supremacy1914.com/forum/index.php?thread/7666]forums[/url] and our [url=https://discord.gg/JRvh3eDYW2]Discord[/url] server.

Best of luck General,
Your Bytro Team

notes.content:

The next Hero to join your ranks in the upcoming Heroes update is a non-historical figure whose name strikes fear into the hearts of his enemies - [b]Orhan "Kangal" Demir[/b]. Based on feedback we received from the community about the first Hero we announced, Viscount Allenby, we thought this armored car specialist would be the perfect defensive counter to Allenby’s attacking prowess. As we move closer to the release, we’re excited to introduce you to this formidable warrior whose cunning and resilience will bring new defensive strategies to your battlefield.

[b]Who Is Orhan “Kangal” Demir?[/b]
Orhan "Kangal" Demir was a rebellious young man from a remote village who, by his teens, gained a reputation for defying authority and outrunning trouble. During a visit to Adrianople, he learned to drive, a skill that would later prove crucial. As World War I reached his homeland, “Kangal”, forgotten by authorities and unregistered for military service, chose to stay and protect his family. Forming a group with those unable to enlist, he led night raids against enemy scouts, utilizing his skills to steal a French-made armored car, which he turned into a formidable weapon. His unit, eventually growing in strength, became notorious for their mobility and surprise attacks, turning villages into strongholds and instilling fear in the enemy, who learned that nothing was undefended in “Kangal’s” territory.

[img]https://www.supremacy1914.com/uploads/pics/1724407523_news_images_31472.jpg[/img]

[b]Orhan “Kangal” Demir’s Skills: Armored Defense Specialist[/b]
When “Kangal” joins your army, he brings with him a set of skills designed to bolster your defenses and ensure your armored cars can withstand any assault. “Kangal” starts with a 10% defense bonus to armored cars when first unlocked, and after you’ve levelled him up to the 5th tier, he deploys with the following skills:
[list][*][b]Iron Wall Defense:[/b] Provides a 20% defense bonus to all armored cars in his army. This ability transforms your armored vehicles into nearly impenetrable bastions, allowing them to hold the line against even the most formidable enemies.[/*][*][b]Armored Vanguard:[/b] Enters the battlefield accompanied by two armored cars, ready to lead your forces with unmatched mobility and strength. These units, enhanced by “Kangal’s” tactical prowess, become key players in executing surprise attacks and reinforcing your defensive positions.[/*][/list]
[b]Get Ready for the Heroes Update![/b]
The arrival of Orhan "Kangal" Demir is just one part of the exciting Heroes update coming soon. As you prepare to rally your forces, remember that Heroes like “Kangal” will play a pivotal role in your strategy, offering unique advantages that could turn the tide of battle in your favour. Keep an eye on our official channels, including the [url=”https://forum.supremacy1914.com/forum/]forum[/url] and our [url=”https://discord.gg/JRvh3eDYW2]Discord[/url] server, for all the latest updates.

notes.title: Heroic Insights
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34123292/f157d396515694e879597e30f936f8a608498a37.jpg[/img]

We're thrilled to share more about the various mechanics of the upcoming Heroes feature that will redefine your strategic gameplay. Following our previous updates on unlocking, deploying and upgrading Heroes, let's delve deeper into how these legendary units will operate on the battlefield.

[b]Key Mechanics of Heroes[/b]
[list][*][b]Stacking Limitations:[/b] To maintain balance and tactical diversity, only one Hero can be in a single army. This encourages thoughtful deployment and enhances the strategic complexity of your forces.[/*][*][b]Mobilisation Times:[/b] Each Hero will have distinct mobilisation times based on balancing requirements. This means that the time it takes for a Hero to become battle-ready will vary, adding a new layer of planning to your campaigns.[/*][*][b]Map Limit:[/b] In our initial release, you'll be able to deploy any number of the available Heroes that you have unlocked on a single map. We intend to add a limit to the number of Heroes deployable in one map at a later point, after release, as we continue to add more Heroes.[/*][*][b]Days of Availability:[/b] Heroes will be available to deploy on different days, so coordinating their placement with your broader strategy will be key to gaining the upper hand.[/*][*][b]Resurrection Cooldown:[/b] Although Heroes are powerful units, they are not invincible. If a Hero is lost in battle, we intend that they won’t be immediately available for redeployment. We’re planning to introduce a resurrection cooldown, which will require you to adapt and rethink your tactics. This feature may not be ready for the initial launch, but if not, it's a top priority for subsequent updates.[/*][/list]
[b]Looking Ahead[/b]
As we continue to refine and perfect the Heroes feature, we look forward to sharing more with you about these exciting new units. Keep an eye out on the [url=https://forum.supremacy1914.com/forum/]forum[/url] and in our Official [url=https://discord.gg/JRvh3eDYW2]Discord[/url] to share your thoughts and learn more about upcoming updates. We’re excited to see how Heroes will transform your strategies and shape the battles to come. Get ready to harness their unique powers and lead your nation to glory!

Best of luck General,
Your Bytro Team

tags.balance_change: Stacking Limitations: To maintain balance and tactical diversity, only one Hero can be in a single army. This encourages thoughtful deployment and enhances the strategic complexity of your forces.

Mobilisation Times: Each Hero will have distinct mobilisation times based on balancing requirements. This means that the time it takes for a Hero to become battle-ready will vary, adding a new layer of planning to your campaigns.

tags.feature: Map Limit: In our initial release, you'll be able to deploy any number of the available Heroes that you have unlocked on a single map. We intend to add a limit to the number of Heroes deployable in one map at a later point, after release, as we continue to add more Heroes.
Days of Availability: Heroes will be available to deploy on different days, so coordinating their placement with your broader strategy will be key to gaining the upper hand.

Resurrection Cooldown: Although Heroes are powerful units, they are not invincible. If a Hero is lost in battle, we intend that they won’t be immediately available for redeployment. We’re planning to introduce a resurrection cooldown, which will require you to adapt and rethink your tactics. This feature may not be ready for the initial launch, but if not, it's a top priority for subsequent updates.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34123292/a027e8f18d978805ebe232584403d65108d08baf.jpg[/img]

The world of Supremacy 1914 is soon to witness a game-changing addition that will redefine your strategies on the battlefield: [b]Heroes[/b]. As the excitement builds for their arrival, we are thrilled to share some details about how you can upgrade these extraordinary figures and maximise their potential to lead your armies to victory.

[b]What Are Heroes?[/b]

Heroes are special units who bring unique skills and abilities to your army, offering new strategic options and advantages. Each Hero has distinct characteristics that can turn the tide of war in your favour, making them invaluable assets in your campaign for supremacy.

[b]Upgrading Heroes: Unlock New Powers[/b]

Upgrading your Heroes is the key to unleashing their full potential. Here's how it works:
[list][*][b]Collect Hero Shards:[/b] Each Hero requires a specific number of shards for an upgrade. For now, shards can be earned through operations and shop purchases. We plan on introducing more ways to earn them later on, for example through rewarded ads and as a reward for winning games. Keep an eye out for opportunities to gather these crucial resources![/*][*][b]Access the Hero Panel:[/b] Once you've collected enough shards, head to the Hero panel on the main page. Here, you can manage your Heroes and track their progress.[/*][*][b]Upgrade to the Next Tier:[/b] Use your shards to upgrade your Hero to the next tier. Each upgrade unlocks powerful new skills or abilities or buffs existing ones, giving you a significant edge over your opponents.[/*][/list]

The introduction of Heroes is just around the corner, be ready to collect shards to upgrade them as soon as they're available. Heroes will be a pivotal part of your army, using their exceptional skills and abilities to turn the battle in your favour. Stay tuned here, in the [url=https://forum.supremacy1914.com/forum/]forum[/url], and in our Official [url=https://discord.gg/JRvh3eDYW2]Discord[/url] server for more updates as we get closer to the release of this exciting new feature!

Your Bytro Team

notes.title: A reminder of what's to come
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34123292/69a061b6c39570447e9549edd9d6a85da33687cb.jpg[/img]

Our team is working hard on bringing our vision for the previously announced Heroes to life. The Beta version of our first Hero - Viscount Allenby - is still available for our Frontline Pioneers to play and try out this great new feature. While we are super excited to share more about what’s coming with all of you, for now we’d like to refresh everyone on Heroes and what they are!

[b]What Happened to Generals?[/b]

You’re probably wondering where the new term “Heroes” came from. We found that “Generals” was too specific and restricted us to a certain kind of image. The term Heroes makes us feel much more comfortable in terms of design freedom. It offers a broader range to add exciting and unique units to the game, that would otherwise not fit the narrow alley of only the highest ranking officers. Heroes is a working title and we’re not quite fixed on this new name, so please bear with us as we figure this out, as this might change again. Of course, if you have any suggestions, we’d love to hear them!

[b]What are Heroes?[/b]

Heroes are enhanced units who have special skills that can buff the army, or specific units in the army that they’re stacked with. For example, our first Hero, Viscount Allenby, is a cavalry Hero whose current skills offer boosts to all of the units, and also specifically the cavalry in his army:

[list][*][b]Increased Movement Speed:[/b] Gives a speed buff to all units in the stack.[/*][*][b]Cavalry Bodyguard:[/b] Starts with cavalry units to bolster your initial setup.[/*][*][b]Enhanced Attack Damage of Cavalry Units:[/b] Increases the attacking strength of Cavalry in the stack.[/*][/list]
[b]The Future of Heroes:[/b]

Viscount Allenby is just the beginning of this new adventure. Our dedicated team is working diligently to bring a diverse set of Heroes to life, enabling you to pick, choose and enhance different strategies, depending on your personal playstyle. There will be different Heroes for different unit types, which you can unlock and upgrade as you progress through the game.

[list][*][b]Persistent Units:[/b] Heroes will be tied to your account and can be used across different maps. Once you unlock them, they can be deployed in several maps at the same time. As with almost all aspects of Heroes, this might change as we further work on enhancing them.[/*][*][b]Upgradeable Heroes:[/b] The current version of Allenby on beta starts on the highest tier, but our intention is that once you’ve unlocked a Hero they start at tier 1 and you will need to upgrade them to progress them to the next tiers and unlock their various skills.[/*][*][b]Deployment Cooldown:[/b] Losing a Hero in battle is not the end for them. Your Hero will still be in your account and can be used again. After a cooldown period your Heroes will be ready to rejoin the fight![/*][/list]
We’d like to give a big thank you to everyone who has shared their feedback with us about the Heroes so far. We’re really enjoying hearing your wonderful suggestions and opinions, and you’ve given us some very helpful insights into how we can deliver the best version of Heroes possible. We really can’t wait to share more with you about them. Stay tuned for regular updates about these incredible new units here, on the [url=https://forum.supremacy1914.com/forum/]forum[/url], and in our [url=https://discord.gg/JRvh3eDYW2]Official Discord[/url].

notes.title: Release Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34123292/327952d825d572cf0ca6d3688ac363e4ce9fffe9.png[/img]

Attention, General!

Prepare for strategic enhancements on the battlefield! We have implemented a series of balancing changes and bug fixes to ensure a smoother and more engaging experience in your campaigns. Let's dive into the details:

[b]Balancing Changes[/b]
[list][*][b]Factory Availability Adjustments[/b]: We've updated the availability of factories, enabling you to bolster your production capabilities sooner. The day of availability for each factory level has been reduced by 2 days:[/*][list][*]Factory Level 1: Now available on Day 6 (previously Day 8)[/*][*]Factory Level 2: Now available on Day 8 (previously Day 10)[/*][*]Factory Level 3: Now available on Day 10 (previously Day 12)[/*][*]Factory Level 4: Now available on Day 12 (previously Day 14)[/*][/list][*][b]Aerodrome Access[/b]: The day of availability has been changed from Day 10 to Day 8 to account for earlier access to factories.[/*][*][b]Railway Accessibility[/b]: Railways will now be available on Day 3, down from Day 5, ensuring quicker troop movements across your empire and a more strategic choice in how you boost your economy in the early days.[/*][*][b]Cavalry Production Time[/b]: Speed is of the essence! The production time for cavalry has been halved. It will now take 12 hours instead of 24 in a province with 100% morale and a Level 2 workshop to produce these swift units. We made this change to allow food-rich nations to advance quicker to the much needed provinces for earlier factories.[/*][/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*][b]Aeroplane Stack Splitting[/b]: We have resolved an issue that caused aeroplanes to teleport back to their home airfield when splitting a stack. The split unit will now correctly travel to its intended destination if within range or return to base if out of range.[/*][*][b]Alliance ELO Rating[/b]: A bug that caused newly formed alliances to start with 0 ELO has been fixed. New alliances will now correctly start with an ELO value of 1000, ensuring fair competition from the get-go.[/*][/list]
We hope these adjustments enhance your strategic planning and overall experience in Supremacy 1914. Onwards to victory!

For a closer look at the changes please check out the [url=https://bytro.helpshift.com/hc/en/3-supremacy-1914/faq/524]detailed list of updates[/url] and share your feedback with us on the [url=https://forum.supremacy1914.com/forum/index.php?thread/7611]forums[/url] and our [url=https://discord.gg/JRvh3eDYW2]Discord[/url] server.

Best of luck General,
Your Bytro Team

notes.title: Generals
notes.content:
[img]https://www.supremacy1914.com/uploads/pics/1718868634_news_images_30837.png[/img]

We are thrilled to invite our Frontline Pioneers to be part of an exclusive testing phase for an exciting new feature: [b]Generals[/b] - starting on June 27th 2024 on beta servers! As Frontline Pioneers, you will get to test the Generals first, and we’d love to know what you think about them.

[b]What Are Generals?[/b]

Generals are special units that come with unique buffs to enhance your army’s capabilities. In the future, they will also feature:
[list]	[*]an intricate progression system,[/*]	[*]unlocking various perks and[/*]	[*]improving their effectiveness as you advance.[/*][/list]
[b]First Test General: Viscount Allenby[/b]

We’re starting with a historical figure, [b]Viscount Allenby[/b], who boasts impressive buffs to the army he commands:
[list]	[*][b]Increased Movement Speed[/b]: Get all your troops on the stack to crucial locations faster![/*]	[*][b]Enhanced Attack Damage of Cavalry Units[/b]: Make your Cavalry even more formidable in battle.[/*]	[*][b]Initial Cavalry Units[/b]: Starts with 3 cavalry units to bolster your initial setup.[/*][/list]
For this first iteration, 2 copies of General Allenby will be deployed in your country when you join the beta game. This is only for the test, and the starting number will be reduced to 1 for the final release version. You will also not be able to have duplicates of the same General in the same map in the final release, but instead there will be more diversity in the Generals available to use. Be advised that these units cannot be produced and you won’t get more during the test, so use them wisely! 

The buff that Generals give to their army do not stack. So consider spreading your Generals out between armies for maximum effect.

Attention, General!

[b]Reworked how trade offers are displayed in the diplomacy window - Fixed critical bugs that prevented armies from engaging in combat - [/b]

This release features bug fixes and improvements aimed at enhancing your strategic warfare experience.

[b]Annoying bug fixes:[/b] We have fixed a bug that was preventing enemy armies from engaging in battle with armies stationed in another player’s province. This was happening when the idle army had right of way with the defending player. Now, the idle army will also have to be defeated to capture the province. We’ve also fixed a visual bug that was displaying a white dot on resources in negative production.

[b]Clearer Trading UI:[/b] In this update, we have reworked the trade resource UI on desktop. Previously, we introduced new graphics and easier principles of the trading process on mobile, and now this has been updated for desktops users too. Now trading will be more transparent and user-friendly for everyone.

Lastly, a bug affecting the display of event and scenario images on the overview page has been squashed. You'll now be able to view these critical visuals in their full glory, without any unsightly zooming issues.

With these fixes in place, you can march forward with increased efficiency and precision. Stay vigilant, generals, and continue to lead your forces to victory on all fronts!

notes.title: Stock Market Changes - Release Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34123292/faf99183487d4640d4c9b8f1be7a05e1bf040eb0.png[/img]

Today's update institutes a market fee, applied to all transactions occurring on the stock market. This fee will constitute 10% of the transaction value, payable in ingame Money regardless of the resource being bought or sold.

We also revisited the method through which AI market prices are established. To impact the current average price point, a significantly larger quantity of resources will now need to be traded on the market. Optimizing this aspect will effectively reduce the severe price fluctuations formerly experienced in the market and further establish a more steady and reliable trading environment.

By making these alterations, we aim to discourage market price manipulation that could result in unfair advantages or disrupt the balance of the map. This has been a long-standing request from our veteran community and we believe this solution will enhance the overall game economy and fairness.

In addition, we have decreased the relative prices of personal market offers, based on the current average price point on the stock market.
This adjustment will mirror the slowed pace of the market price changes. It also means that the personal offers will adjust slower in price, as they are dependent on each other. To alleviate concern that the market becomes too expensive, we are lowering the relative prices of these personal offers slightly.

Please note that the above-mentioned changes to the stock market only affect games created after today's update. Games that were created before the update are not affected by the changes.

Last but not least, we've focused on enhancing gameplay by squashing several significant bugs. We rectified an inconvenience regarding the Delaying March mechanism which was previously operating on in-game time rather than real-time hours, specifically for maps with a speed factor higher than 1.
Additionally, we've ensured that rewards will be properly displayed in the Advisor Reward pop-up, allowing players to see and claim their rewards successfully.

For a closer look at the changes please check out the [url=https://bytro.helpshift.com/hc/en/3-supremacy-1914/faq/478]detailed list of updates[/url] and share your feedback with us on the [url=https://forum.supremacy1914.com/forum/index.php?thread/7500]forums[/url] and our <a href"https://discord.gg/JRvh3eDYW2">Discord[/url] server.

Best of luck General,
Your Bytro Team

notes.title: Release Notes - 2023-10-04
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34123292/faf99183487d4640d4c9b8f1be7a05e1bf040eb0.png[/img]

Attention, General!

We’ve adjusted the defensive behavior of stealth units. Stealth units stationed in a province center were able to get locked into combat with attacking armies, without being revealed in the process. To avoid this confusing situation, stationary, defending stealth units are always revealed to the attacker. This happens regardless of whether they are stationed in a province center, or part of a larger army with other, visible units.

We also fixed an issue that caused the health bar in the unit label to display a higher amount of hitpoints than actually available. Now the health bar will accurately reflect the hitpoint-value displayed in the Army Bar.
And finally, the message notification icon for the alliance chat will now display the correct number of new messages.

For a closer look at the changes please check out the [url="https://bytro.helpshift.com/hc/en/3-supremacy-1914/faq/439"]detailed list of updates[/url] and share your feedback with us on the [url="https://forum.supremacy1914.com/forum/index.php?thread/7186"]forums[/url] and our [url="https://discord.gg/JRvh3eDYW2"]Discord[/url] server.

Best of luck General,
Your Bytro Team

notes.title: Release Notes - 2023-06-27
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34123292/faf99183487d4640d4c9b8f1be7a05e1bf040eb0.png[/img]

Attention, General!

We are excited to announce a new mobile feature in Supremacy 1914 - the Offerwall! This new feature is a great way for you to earn gold and enhance your gaming experience. With the Offerwall you can complete various tasks and offers from our advertising partners to earn free Goldmarks. Starting tomorrow, the Offerwall feature can be found under the shop and rewards icon in the app.  
 
This update introduces highly requested adjustments to the speed maps you've been asking for. Previously, certain in-game features within speed maps remained unaltered, giving the impression that the map was at a regular speed. However, we have thoroughly reviewed and improved these features to accurately reflect the speed of each map going forward. 
 
In addition to that, we addressed adviser tasks. Advisers now only show tasks related to promoting units if the player has already researched them. Also we fixed a bug with adviser rewards, enabling players to claim them instantly instead of experiencing delays. 
 
Last but not least, we got rid of that annoying bug that made infantry units that are about to spawn teleport anywhere in the map. This caused some confusion and units suddenly appearing where they should not. Luckily, this bug is not in the game anymore. 
 

For a closer look at the changes please check out the [url="https://bytro.helpshift.com/hc/en/3-supremacy-1914/faq/416"]detailed list of updates[/url] and share your feedback with us on the [url="https://forum.supremacy1914.com/forum/index.php?thread/6939"]forums[/url] and our [url="https://discord.gg/JRvh3eDYW2"]Discord[/url] server.

notes.title: Rush for Europe
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34123292/d127ac7ad18662f2ddd247b314e5747d20bc26cb.jpg[/img]

Attention, Generals!

Time flies, as they say! Just like those new fighter aircrafts and bombers these days. The Germans are deploying troops, the Tsar increased military spending and the Royal Navy is on high alert! It looks like we are only hours away until war breaks out in Europe.

Mobilize your troops and prepare yourself for whatever enemy you may face! “Rush for Europe” is a special event map which runs on breathtaking 6 times the speed of normal game rounds! Even the tiniest decision could have severe consequences at this pace. Experience the war for Europe in a way you have never seen it before!
